name: freebuff-termux-host
description: Host projects on your Android phone with Termux — serve static sites, Node/Python apps on localhost/LAN and expose them with a tunnel. Designed for the Freebuff mobile app / terminal.
author: freebuff

tools.name: host_serve
tools.description: Start hosting a project directory on a port (auto-detect static / node / python). Blocks until stopped or runs detached with --detach.

tools.name: host_status
tools.description: List hosted projects, PIDs, ports, and LAN URLs.

tools.name: host_stop
tools.description: Stop a hosted project by name or port.

tools.name: host_tunnel
tools.description: Expose a hosted port publicly via cloudflared / pinggy / ngrok (first available).

tools.name: host_wake_lock
tools.description: Acquire/release Termux wake lock so Android doesn't kill the server.

skills.name: host-project
skills.description: Workflow to host any project on Termux: detect type, pick port, serve, verify, tunnel, keep alive.
